subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Devoid
solution:
The correct answer is 'Lacking'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Devoid is an adjective that means entirely lacking or free from.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Entire - with no part left out; whole.
 
• Filled - cause (a space or container) to become full or almost full.
 
• Lacking - (of a quality) absent.
 
• Complete - having all the necessary or appropriate parts.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that lacking is the correct synonym for the word devoid.
